Road Accident.description: Standard operating procedure for road accident emergencies

HIGH: Immediately dispatch ambulance to the reported location
Notify police for traffic management and investigation
Confirm exact location and nearest landmark
Ask caller: Are any vehicles on fire or leaking fuel?
Ask caller: Are any victims trapped inside vehicles?
Check number of injured people and severity of injuries
Dispatch fire & rescue if vehicles are trapped or on fire
Keep caller on line until emergency services arrive
Notify nearest trauma center / emergency hospital
Document incident for follow-up and reporting
MEDIUM: Dispatch ambulance to the reported location
Confirm exact location and nearest landmark
Advise caller to keep victims still and not move them
Keep caller on line until emergency services arrive
LOW: Take down location and incident details
Advise caller on basic first aid if needed

Medical Emergency.description: Standard operating procedure for medical emergencies

HIGH: Immediately dispatch ambulance with advanced life support
Ask caller: Is the patient conscious and breathing?
Guide caller through CPR if patient is not breathing
Identify patient symptoms and medical history if available
Confirm exact location and access route
Alert nearest emergency hospital of incoming patient
Dispatch paramedic response team if available
Document all symptoms for hospital handover
MEDIUM: Provide basic first aid instructions to caller
LOW: Take down patient details and symptoms
Advise caller on nearest medical facility

Fire.description: Standard operating procedure for fire emergencies

HIGH: Confirm exact location and building details
Ask caller: Are any people trapped inside?
Ask caller: What type of fire (electrical, gas, structural)?
Notify police for area cordoning and crowd control
Alert nearest hospital of possible burn victims
Contact gas/electricity authority if utility fire
Keep caller on line and advise evacuation route
MEDIUM: Ask caller: Is anyone inside the building?

Crime.description: Standard operating procedure for crime-related emergencies

HIGH: Immediately dispatch police to the location
Keep caller calm and on the line
Advise caller: Do not confront the perpetrator
Confirm exact location and suspect description
Alert nearby patrol units for rapid response
Do not broadcast over public channels if ongoing crime
MEDIUM: Advise caller to stay safe and not engage suspect

Missing Person.description: Standard operating procedure for missing person reports

HIGH: Gather full description: age, appearance, last seen location/time
Check if vulnerable person (child, elderly, disability)
Document full details including photos if available
Contact family members for additional information
MEDIUM: Gather full description and last known location
Alert patrol units in the area

Natural Disaster.description: Standard operating procedure for natural disasters

HIGH: Deploy medical teams and field hospitals
Request mutual aid from neighboring districts
Document all actions and resources deployed
MEDIUM: Dispatch ambulance and rescue teams as needed

HIGH: Confirm location and nature of emergency
